native_gate: Skip trim interval/system allocator/arena limit if both direct and post-GC trims return under 30 MiB at every probe snapshot.
pass_line: frames no worse than adjacent fresh v1 baselines
stop_line: Exit 75: five-minute wait, at most six retries; stop the measurement schedule if still refused. Other failures stop immediately.
noise: Record host load, free memory, selected executable counts each snapshot. Pause 30s between games to release the lock.
scope: Only reviews/49-memory-cuts changes. Measurement jars/worlds/logs local. No shipping settings or mods.
